input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. §14.1 confirms Customer owns Customer Data, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right (further constrained by §15.1's no-sale/no-training/no-advertising restrictions). §14.2 vests Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment plus personnel assignments and further-assurance. §14.3 lets Vendor retain only Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business. §14.4 bars joint ownership absent a signed instrument and keeps feedback rights with Customer. The only minor points, noted but not flagged: the deliverable assignment is conditioned on payment of Fees, and §14.1's processing right extends to "improve the Services" (mitigated by §15.1). No redline required.
